feature_definitions.direct_distance: Haversine distance from first to last sample, in meters.
feature_definitions.large_turn_count: Wrapped heading changes >=100 degrees on segments >=max(8 m, 1.25x median accuracy).
feature_definitions.longest_stop_seconds: Longest anchor-radius episode with low cluster speed, in seconds.
feature_definitions.max_speed: Maximum Haversine segment distance / timestamp delta, in m/s.
feature_definitions.mean_accuracy: Arithmetic mean of available reported horizontal accuracy, in meters.
feature_definitions.median_speed: Median Haversine segment distance / positive timestamp delta, in m/s.
feature_definitions.path_length: Sum of adjacent Haversine distances, in meters.
feature_definitions.speed_std: Population standard deviation of Haversine segment speeds, in m/s.
feature_definitions.stop_ratio: Accepted low-movement episode seconds divided by window span, bounded to [0, 1].
feature_definitions.tortuosity: min(10, path_length / max(direct_distance, 10 m)); bounded for near-zero displacement.

preprocessing: none; Isolation Forest uses random feature splits
window_definition: trailing_elapsed_time; inclusive observed samples; minimum 90% span
